name: get_project_info
description: Premiere version, open project, all sequences, the active (or named) sequence with every video/audio track, clip (start/end/in/out seconds, media, effects) and marker, plus top-level project items.

sequence.description: Sequence name or id. Omit for the active sequence.

tracks.description: Include tracks and clips. Default true.

name: list_items
description: Project panel tree: bins, clips, sequences, with media paths.

bin.description: Bin name or "Bin/Sub" path. Default: root.

name: project
description: open (a .prproj), new (create a .prproj at path), save, save_as, close.

name: import_files
description: Import media files (video, audio, images, .psd/.ai, .mogrt not here) into a bin (created if missing).

as_sequence.description: Import numbered stills as an image sequence.

name: create_sequence
description: Create a sequence: from project items (matches their settings, clips laid end to end) or from a .sqpreset (default HD 1080p 29.97). width/height override the frame size, e.g. 1080x1920 for a vertical reel.

items.description: Project items to build it from.

name: add_clip
description: Put a project item on a track at a time (seconds; default: end of that track). mode overwrite (default) or insert (ripples). Optional source in/out seconds.

name: clip_action
description: Act on a timeline clip: remove, ripple_delete, move (to start or by moveBy seconds), trim (start/end on the timeline, in/out in the source), rename, disable, enable, select, speed (percent, optional reverse).

clip.description: 0-based index on the track, or clip name.

name: set_clip_property
description: Read or set an effect property on a clip, optionally keyframed. Omit component to list components; omit property to read them all. Examples: component "Motion" property "Scale" (100 = 100%), "Position" ([0.5, 0.5] = center, normalized), "Rotation"; component "Opacity" property "Opacity". keyframes = [{time (sequence seconds), value}].

name: apply_effect
description: Add a video or audio effect to a clip by its English name, e.g. "Gaussian Blur", "Lumetri Color", "Warp Stabilizer", "Crop", "Ultra Key", "Black & White", "DeNoise".

name: add_transition
description: Add a transition at the start or end of a clip. Default "Cross Dissolve" (video) / "Constant Power" (audio), 1 s. Others: "Dip to Black", "Dip to White", "Film Dissolve", "Push", "Slide".

name: markers
description: list, add (time, name, comment, duration, color index 0-7) or clear sequence markers.

name: playhead
description: Read or set the playhead and the sequence in/out points (seconds). Also makes the sequence active.

name: preview_frame
description: Render one sequence frame (default: at the playhead) and return it as an image so you can see the edit.

name: export_sequence
description: Export a sequence to a file. Default preset: H.264 Match Source - High bitrate (.mp4). range all / inout / workarea. queue=true sends it to Adobe Media Encoder instead of exporting in Premiere (which blocks Premiere until done).

name: import_mogrt
description: Add a Motion Graphics Template (.mogrt, e.g. a title) to the timeline and set its parameters by display name (text params take a plain string).

name: run_extendscript
description: Escape hatch: run any Premiere ExtendScript and get the last expression's value back. app.enableQE() unlocks the QE DOM. Helpers: findSeq, findItem, findClip, getTrack, describeSeq, describeClip, toTime, secs, qeSequence.
